tet4.validation_boundary: reference signed volume must exceed 1e-14; current det(F) must exceed 1e-10

hex8.validation_boundary: positive reference Jacobian and current det(F) must exceed 1e-10 at every integration point

route.residual_convention: solver residual is lambda F_ext - F_int - F_contact; no contact is in WP04 scope
route.tangent_convention: assembled dF_int/du equals material plus initial-stress geometric contributions
route.scope_enforcement: homogeneous element family/material, isotropic_3d, nodal dead loads; current implementation breadth is deliberately narrower in the WP04 claim

audit_conclusion: Source implementation matches the documented Total-Lagrangian StVK equations. This is an implementation identity finding, not a maturity decision.
